add_en: Gain and feedback assistants speed up live setup.
The passive ribbon handles up to 135 dB without complaint.
Stringing through the body adds sustain; top-loading sharpens attack.
Luminlay markers stay visible on dark stages.
The dirty channel cleans up when pick attack softens.
Unison reshapes impedance and gain staging to match modeled hardware.
The six-block architecture supports complex dual-amp setups.
Noiseless pickups remove the 60-cycle hum a Strat has carried since 1954.
Height offers two fixed settings, without continuous adjustment.
Thirty-two glowing pads replace menus for arranging by ear.
Built-in speakers handle home practice without extra gear.
It doubles as a floor wedge or compact main.
A 57-degree angle aims sound straight at the ears.
Silky ALPS faders and mute groups keep the analog workflow tactile.
Presets dial in specific microphones and instruments in seconds.
The open-back cups leak sound, ruling out tracking sessions.
Built-in speakers and rich resonance make it a self-contained piano.
Its console cabinet is designed to sit in a living room.
Hardware loopback routes streams with zero latency.
The plugins require UAD DSP hardware like a Satellite.
Editable FM synthesis and probability tools add variation.
One-knob compressors on the first channels tame uneven singing.
Its magnetic array reaches 1.5 Tesla for controlled, detailed bass.
A three-band EQ and LCD display simplify setup.
